rules.condition: hardware and software attempt to write the register at the same time
rules.statement: The subreg for R0W1C/RW1S/RW1C/RW0C types must handle simultaneous hardware and software write attempts.
Software has precedence over hardware, as for the RW type.

rules.condition: hardware is writing a RW1C register
rules.statement: The hardware value is sent to the logic that potentially clears that value or the stored value.
Hardware should feed the q value back into d, only setting bits with new events, to avoid collisions with software clearing.

rules.condition: software clears a RW1C bit while the hardware d input is still 1
rules.statement: The software clear must still take effect for one cycle to create a new interrupt edge, then q returns to 1 since d is still 1.
RW1C, RW1S and similar register types may be created with hwext true.

rules.condition: RW1C, RW1S or similar register has hwext true
rules.statement: The auto-generated hardware is the same as the hwext RW register, with the implementation done outside the generated register block.

rules.condition: clearing is to be monitored by external hardware
rules.statement: hwqe may be set true for these register types.
